description: Source code for CodeMirror's tag-closer extension, providing auto-closing of HTML/XML tags with configurable options.

methods.name: autoCloseGT
methods.description: Automatically closes a '>' in an HTML/XML tag, inserting the closing tag if appropriate.

methods.name: autoCloseCurrent
methods.description: Handles auto-closing of tags when typing '/' or '</', including indentation and insertion of closing tags.

methods.name: autoCloseSlash
methods.description: Triggers auto-closing when a slash is typed.

methods.name: indexOf
methods.description: Utility function to find the index of an element in a collection.

methods.name: closingTagExists
methods.description: Checks if a closing tag exists for a given tag in the current context.
